title: A YouTuber trolled his 2.5 million fans to make a great point about the blind loyalty of Apple and Android fans (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL)
text: A YouTuber trolled his 2.5 million fans to make a great point about the blind loyalty of Apple and Android fans (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL) By Paige Leskin Oct 8, 2018, 5:36 pm 22 pts YouTuber Jonathan Morrison posted selfies to Instagram that he said he took with a Google Pixel 2 phone in portrait mode. However, Morrison lied, and actually took the pictures with the new iPhone XS. Morrison, a tech reviewer, was demonstrating how people let their loyalty to a brand color their…
